releases.name: Speed Weaver
releases.summary: Weave through chaotic highway traffic, dodge hazards, and split lanes at breakneck speeds in Speed Weaver—a high-octane, score-attack arcade driving game. Level up to unlock 20 tiers of performance vehicles, master hard-mode physics, and dominate weekly event leaderboards. Can you thread the needle?

releases.name: The Last Brazilian
releases.summary: Choose your class from illustrative figures and face hordes of enemies in intense 2D platforming combat across the country. Defeat iconic state bosses and unlock unique powers with each game. Will you be The Last Brazilian?

releases.name: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno
releases.summary: NITRO ORIGIN's debut title, Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO, is coming to Steam! A web of swirling conspiracies. A whirlwind of bullets. Amidst it all, a poignant tale of a boy and a girl unfolds...

releases.name: Thorgard
releases.summary: Vikings, pirates, and suspiciously organized ducks all want a sip of your legendary mead. Grab your axe, mow down the horde, and defend Thorgard's finest brew.... one swing at a time.

releases.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
releases.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice. With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.

Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.

Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

releases.name: Fracture Point
releases.summary: After years in prison, you return to a dark megacity ruled by a ruthless corporation. The only way forward is up - through countless floors of a heavily guarded skyscraper - to reach the corporation's leader and take your revenge.

releases.name: Isle of Reveries
releases.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and explore a vast overworld in this retro-inspired adventure.

releases.name: Reality Rivals: The First Season
releases.summary: Reality Rivals is the reality show you can play. Compete in challenges, form alliances, and survive the vote in this social strategy game. Every choice shapes the drama. Will you avoid Exile, and beat your Rivals?
